name: basilisk-portal
//types: Read by /design-sync only. The sync converter extracts each component's prop contract from the package's declared type root; this app has no dist, so without this pointer every shipped .d.ts was `[key: string]: unknown`. `.ds-types/` is gitignored build output — regenerate with `npm run build:types` (tsconfig.dts.json). Nothing imports basilisk-portal and it is `private`, so this field is inert for Vite, vitest, `tsc --noEmit` and anything that ships to users.

scripts.//typecheck: Two configs, one script, because CI's `Typecheck portal` step runs the script. The second pass is .design-sync/previews/ — 50 .tsx files outside web/ that tsconfig.json's `include` has never reached and that resolve `basilisk-portal` and `react` only through tsconfig.previews.json's `paths`. They went unchecked long enough to accumulate 60 errors, and the design-sync capture step cannot find them: a preview that throws still produces an image of something. Chained rather than left as a config somebody has to remember, which is the same defect one level up.
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.js
